scope: Local and time-integrated probability backflow in a homogeneous Hermitian nearest-neighbor cosine lattice, especially a single Gaussian near ka=pi/2 and its oscillatory tails.
sources: Official arXiv abstract/version records, HTML and versioned PDFs
University of the West of Scotland author accepted manuscript repository
queries: "General Quantum Backflow in Realistic Wave Packets"
"Searching for Bloch wave packets with almost definite momentum direction"
deduplication: ArXiv and APS records were merged by identifier/DOI. Version updates were not counted as additional papers.
excluded_or_separated: Neural-quantum-state backflow ansatz: different use of the word backflow
Information backflow in noisy quantum walks: not probability current backflow
Gain-loss PT-symmetric source-drain reverse flow: not the homogeneous Hermitian mechanism
Disorder scattering or boomerang return: not the positive-velocity free-lattice test
Continuum Gaussian-superposition results: useful criterion context, not an exact cosine-lattice example
limitations: Bounded targeted search, not an exhaustive systematic review. No exact single-Gaussian pi/2 Airy-tail backflow example was located, but this absence is not a novelty claim.
retrieval_failures: The local Python requests package was absent; urllib was used successfully instead.
The institutional Bloch accepted-PDF URL returned HTTP 503 in terminal download; official arXiv v2 was downloaded successfully.
